Operational transfer guidance describes a 21-unit major while the current AI catalog uses 22; the four-transfer-unit cap agrees, and the current AI total is preserved.

findings.issue: Explicit current course-directory titles were missing from eleven advanced-exception records.
findings.resolution: Owner populated the eleven exact known titles; examination-credit COMP_SCI 1CA remains null rather than invented.

checks.fixed_requirements: Both original route pages require 208/211/212/348/349 and have true 180 OR111 alternatives; non-McCormick adds 150 OR GEN_ENG150 OR151. Manual fixed set and subjects match.
checks.choice_rules: McCormick four advanced electives and both six technical electives are actual choices with open eligibility, not contextual notes. Five of six distinct domains remain nested; societal-impact count one and non-McCormick calculus whole-sequence OR routes preserved. No internal double-count permissions inferred.
checks.classification: Manual code/topic identity category sets independently transcribed from original program rows and course bodies before graph comparison. 27 common systems options, 24 common AI, honest mixed and unclassified generic topics. Exact totals and identities match.
checks.eligibility: Engineering expressly allows BSE majors as additional majors accompanying primary studies; both second-major routes retain award other. 11 unique AI units apply to both; McCormick primary major uniqueness separately preserved. Home-school Communication/Bienen conflicts and math enrollability issues remain unresolved.
checks.credits_prerequisites: Actual current course blocks and source preparation/permission/duplicate-credit prose checked. Unit counts retained as Northwestern units; no conversion or automatic prerequisite-chain obligation added. COMP_SCI469 requires undergrad instructor permission; MATH310 prerequisite/corequisite alternatives and Math enrollability restrictions retained.
checks.versions: 2018 P/N PDF has no AI departmental row; 2025–2026 non-WCAS PDF applies to WCAS credentials. Both one-page renderings visually inspected. Public21-unit transfer wording differs from current22-unit catalog and remains a blocker.

limitations: Acceptance is limited to the represented local graph and stated evidence scope; primary blocked status remains appropriate.
